stem.text: The diagram shows a stationary wave, at time $t = 0$, that has been set up on a string fixed between points P and S.

stem.alt: Diagram of a horizontal string fixed at both ends by hatched walls, labelled P at the left end and S at the right end, with points X, Q, R and Y marked along it; an arrow below X points downward.

stem.text: The nodes of the stationary wave occur on the string at P, Q, R and S. Point X is moving down at time $t = 0$. The points on the string vibrate with time period $T$ and maximum amplitude $2\,\text{cm}$.
The displacement $s$ is positive in the upward direction.
Which graph best shows the variation with $t$ of the displacement $s$ of point Y on the string?

A.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled s / cm from -2 to 2 and horizontal axis labelled t, with T/2 marked on the t axis.

B.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled s / cm from -2 to 2 and horizontal axis labelled t, with T/2 marked on the t axis.

C.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled s / cm from -2 to 2 and horizontal axis labelled t, with T/2 marked on the t axis.

D.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled s / cm from -2 to 2 and horizontal axis labelled t, with T/2 marked on the t axis.
